name: personal-agent-assistant-workspace
description: 面向 macOS 和 Windows 的个人工作助手

scripts.format: prettier --write apps/desktop/src apps/web/src packages tests/web tests/desktop tests/e2e scripts "apps/*/*.{json,ts}" "packages/*/package.json" *.json *.ts *.mjs ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/desktop/src apps/web/src packages tests/web tests/desktop tests/e2e scripts "apps/*/*.{json,ts}" "packages/*/package.json" *.json *.ts *.mjs ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:python
scripts.test:smoke:quick: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/desktop/app.spec.ts tests/e2e/desktop/summary.spec.ts
scripts.test:smoke:asr: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/desktop/transcription.spec.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:core && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run build:core && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.json --dir --publish never
